summary: Connect full cell execution to the represented TorchLean operator and prove ordered assembly traversal correctness, access safety and execution existence from actual loop instructions.

examined.reason: Add explicit per-coefficient representation and dimension transport, then prove actual operator equality. Add fetched comparison/branch loop extraction, ordered accumulation, allocated-array safety and general existence by decreasing remaining entries.
Document operator representation and isolated assembly loop guarantees, preserving full assembly entry/output, external serialization and launch obligations.
No equation, TorchLean algorithm, emitted GPU kernel, or host solver changed. This strengthens proof composition only.

Manual review checked branch predicates and targets, unsigned cursor wrap exclusion, actual index/value loads, ordered binary64 addition and state preservation. Traversal extraction and reconstruction both use fetched steps. Witness fuel cannot return a partial success. Emitted loop binding excludes the isolated terminal ret and explicitly retains entry/mask/output composition. No desired read, sum or iteration count is an execution premise; no new hardware conformance claim.

results.method: Complete registered Lean build; fresh AssemblyChecks kernel regressions; exact PtxIntegrationAudit dependency audit; source guards and pinned dependency check; saved Poisson binding checkers including whole-cell counters and assembly loop text; 26 Python Poisson tests; Stratic validation and manual proof/contract review.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and 16 verified dependency pins; local CPU checking, saved GPU artifacts only. No GPU rerun or paid model calls.
results.evidence: 4170 exact dependency reports, only standard Lean axioms; 460 guarded files; complete registered build and fresh nonzero cancellation, empty range, insufficient fuel and invalid-index checks passed. 60 assembly loop slices, 90 whole cell entries, 720 contractions and 630 shared stores bound across 30 saved layouts; true_residual binding also passed. 386 receipt source hashes verified. 26 Python tests passed. Stratic valid and git diff --check clean; README unchanged. Complete cell theorem now names represented operator coefficients. Assembly loop correctness and general existence follow from fetched control/data steps and allocated initial arrays. Full assembly entry/output, launch composition and other solver obligations remain open.

unmapped.reason: Reviewed supporting coefficient representation, fetched assembly loop semantics and existence proofs, build/audit registration, source-bound receipts, mutation checks or explanatory documentation for the mapped correspondence contracts.
